method: Direct raw-label support only. support = distinct corpus records whose own technique labels name the node's technique. A broad label backs its umbrella node and nothing narrower; labels with no direct home stay unmapped; nodes supported only by promotion are deleted (see repair.deleted_nodes).

deleted_nodes.reason: No record carries board-per-domain; generic dashboards do not state division into work/money/health/decisions. Recast as tech-ia-dashboard-layout (generic board), and keep the domain split as [P] local policy in r4/r5.

No record states source-provenance. logs/metrics/cost-tracking directly state log, metric and cost surfaces (now their own nodes); they do not entail a provenance/attribution claim. Provenance survives only as [P].
No record states a named-dependency degraded banner; generic status is now tech-trust-status-indicator. The banner is a [P] local policy.
No record states uncertainty/partiality/unmeasured encoding. Eval and chart labels are now their own nodes. Uncertainty display is [P].
No record states a budget threshold; generic alerting is tech-trust-alerting. Budget thresholds are a [P] local policy.
No record states quota or wallet; payments/usage pricing is now tech-money-billing. Quota/wallet/lease composition is [P] local policy.
No record states an actor audit trail; those labels directly state a release/deploy feed (now tech-ops-release-feed). Audit trail is [P].

renamed_nodes.reason: The label set is tables; only 3 records state virtualization.
The direct mark is a trace/waterfall timeline, not a gantt.
Renderer/performance labels; only 2 records state decimation.

recast_nodes.reason: Keep the generic board support; drop the unsupported domain split.

split_merge.rule: Never split a broad label into a narrower leaf it does not state.

merges.reason: Board labels denote one generic board/grid surface.
Table synonyms; virtualization kept as a sub-claim note only.

deleted_splits.reason: Deleted: chart-types states chart types, not those marks. chart-types is now its own umbrella tech-viz-chart-types.
Deleted: status is now tech-trust-status-indicator; the degraded banner was promotion.
Deleted: metrics is now tech-ops-metrics; provenance was promotion.
Deleted: logs back the log stream only; provenance was promotion.
Deleted: cost-tracking backs cost attribution only.
Deleted: alerting backs alerting only; budget thresholds were promotion.
Deleted: accessibility is not a split label; each technique is backed only by its own labels.
